asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Call `props()` to spread the part's props, passing your own to merge them rather than overwrite them.
The state arrives as an accessor:
`render={(props, state) => <button {...props({ onClick: mine })}>{state().open}</button>}`

valueText.description:
The textual value of the option. Used in typeahead navigation of the menu.
If not provided, the text content of the menu item will be used.

anchorPoint.description: The positioning point for the menu. Can be set by the context menu trigger or the button trigger.

aria-label.description: The accessibility label for the menu

closeOnSelect.description: Whether to close the menu when an option is selected

composite.description: Whether the menu is a composed with other composite widgets like a combobox or tabs

defaultHighlightedValue.description:
The initial highlighted value of the menu item when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the highlighted value of the menu item.

defaultOpen.description:
The initial open state of the menu when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the menu.

defaultTriggerValue.description:
The initial trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the trigger value.

highlightedValue.description: The controlled highlighted value of the menu item.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the menu. Useful for composition.

immediate.description: Whether to synchronize the present change immediately or defer it to the next frame

loopFocus.description: Whether to loop the keyboard navigation.

navigate.description: Function to navigate to the selected item if it's an anchor element

onEnterComplete.description: Function called when the animation ends in the open state

onEscapeKeyDown.description: Function called when the escape key is pressed

onExitComplete.description: Function called when the animation ends in the closed state

onFocusOutside.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

onHighlightChange.description: Function called when the highlighted menu item changes.

onInteractOutside.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

onOpenChange.description: Function called when the menu opens or closes

onPointerDownOutside.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

onRequestDismiss.description: Function called when this layer is closed due to a parent layer being closed

onSelect.description: Function called when a menu item is selected.

onTriggerValueChange.description: Function called when the trigger value changes.

open.description: The controlled open state of the menu

positioning.description: The options used to dynamically position the menu

present.description: Whether the node is present (controlled by the user)

skipAnimationOnMount.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

typeahead.description: Whether the pressing printable characters should trigger typeahead navigation

immediate.description: Whether to synchronize the present change immediately or defer it to the next frame

onEnterComplete.description: Function called when the animation ends in the open state

onExitComplete.description: Function called when the animation ends in the closed state

present.description: Whether the node is present (controlled by the user)

skipAnimationOnMount.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.
